answer: To block mass-produced identities, verified work travels by whisper through established agents, each adding an onyx token bound to its sender. The whisper crosses a canyon that checks tokens and stops forged chains. Standing needs a whisper with a full token chain from independent agents. Farm whispers carry only their own tokens, so one origin shows and the chain is rejected. 1000 fakes need 1000 chains; one honest agent needs one genuine chain.
